INVALID_LINK.zh: 这不是完整的 Riffet 链接串，请重新复制
INVALID_LINK.en: This is not a complete Riffet link string; copy it again

INVALID_LINK_ALIAS.zh: 短别名只能用小写字母、数字和 . _ -，且以字母或数字开头
INVALID_LINK_ALIAS.en: Alias may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and . _ -, starting with a letter or digit

INVALID_LINK_URL.zh: 地址要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
INVALID_LINK_URL.en: The address must start with http:// or https://

LINK_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.zh: 链接串里没有可连的地址，请改用 riffet link ssh
LINK_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.en: The link string has no address to reach; use riffet link ssh instead

LINK_ALIAS_TAKEN.zh: 短别名 {alias} 已被另一台服务器使用
LINK_ALIAS_TAKEN.en: Alias {alias} is already used by another linked server

LINK_EXPIRED.zh: 链接串已过期或已用过，请重新生成
LINK_EXPIRED.en: The link string has expired or was already used; create a new one

LINK_FORBIDDEN.zh: 这项操作不能经互联进行，请打开对方的网页
LINK_FORBIDDEN.en: This can't be done through a server link; open the other server's own page

LINK_INBOUND_DISABLED.zh: 对方未允许这台服务器操作它
LINK_INBOUND_DISABLED.en: The other server doesn't let this one operate it

LINK_INSECURE_TRANSPORT.zh: 连接未加密，链接串可能被截获。请在本机网页、HTTPS 地址或命令行里操作
LINK_INSECURE_TRANSPORT.en: This connection isn't encrypted, so the link string could be intercepted. Use this computer's own page, an HTTPS address, or the command line

LINK_MISMATCH.zh: 对方的身份和互联时记录的不一致
LINK_MISMATCH.en: The other server's identity doesn't match the one it linked with

LINK_NOT_ALLOWED.zh: {name} 未允许这台服务器操作它
LINK_NOT_ALLOWED.en: {name} doesn't let this server operate it

LINK_NOT_FOUND.zh: 没有这台互联的服务器

LINK_PROOF_INVALID.zh: 链接串和对方不匹配，请重新生成
LINK_PROOF_INVALID.en: The link string doesn't match the other server; create a new one

LINK_REMOVED.en: The other server ended the link

LINK_SELF.zh: 这个链接串是在这台服务器上生成的
LINK_SELF.en: This link string was created on this server

REMOTE_EXEC_BUSY.zh: 目标服务器正在执行的远端命令已达上限，请稍后再试
REMOTE_EXEC_BUSY.en: The target server is already running the maximum number of remote commands; try again shortly
